title: Manager - WCO
description:
**Enjoy a career, packaged with care, whilst helping protect food, people and the planet**
 We are a key global provider of sustainable packaging solutions. We’re on a mission to make all packaging recyclable, reusable, or compostable. Every day, we ensure the hygiene and safety of food and drink for people around the world. We are Huhtamaki.
   

  

 You could be part of our vision. Because it’s our talented people that make it happen. Our people on the shop floor producing innovative, sustainable products. Our people in our offices delivering excellence for our customers every day. It’s every one of us working together.
   

  

 We offer a place where you can feel safe, be supported, and make an impact so we can all focus on the future together.
   

  

 The Manager \- WCO is responsible for implementing Total Productive Maintenance strategies to improve equipment efficiency, reduce downtime, and enhance production processes. Lead WCO initiatives, coordinate with various stake holders, train pillar members, and drive continuous improvement projects to achieve operational excellence.
   

  

**WCO Implementation** 
 : Develop and execute the WCO strategy to enhance productivity, minimize downtime, and improve overall equipment efficiency (OEE).
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Team Coordination:** 
 Lead cross\-functional teams to drive TPM pillars such as Safety, AM, PM, QM, FI \& E\&T
   

  

**Continuous Improvement Projects:** 
 Initiate and manage improvement projects aimed at reducing waste, improving processes, and increasing production efficiency.
   

  

**Key Performance Indicator (KPI) Monitoring:** 
 Monitor and report on WCO\-related KPIs, such as OEE, mean time between failures (MTBF), and mean time to repair (MTTR)
   

  

**Capability Building:** 
 Facilitate knowledge\-sharing sessions and skill enhancement programs for pillar members to strengthen their understanding and application of WCO principles.
   

  

**Qualification –** 
 Degree / Master Degree
   

  

 Proven industrial experience in TPM lead role in a manufacturing sector.
   

  

 Good communication skills, leadership quality, the ability to collaborate with stakeholders \& HODS.
   

  

 Strong analytical and problem solving skills, including the ability to analyze data and identify opportunities for improvement.
   

  

 Knowledge of process improvement methodologies, such as Lean, TPM or Six Sigma. Familiarity with relevant regulations and standards in the OEE Understanding \& Quality Tools.
   

  

 Join us. Help protect food, people and the planet.
